name: Shindou Masanari
source:
"I will not allow you to secrecy. Answer all that is asked."

He is the second son of the Shindou family, which is a noble family. After graduating from the Yokohama Naval Academy at the top of his class, he is a member of the Secret Military Service.

He is strict with himself and others. He is prideful and looks down on women.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index2.php]official website[/url]]
